task_description: Evaluate and improve the student agent's behavioral discipline: evidence reading order, teacher handoff trigger precision, engineer handoff scope, prediction/self-check loop simplicity, stopping rule clarity, and defensible-revision definition.
scoring_rule: llm_judge — open-ended agent quality; rows provide reference behavior and criteria for judgment.

approved.name: .github/agents/student.agent.md (current source)
approved.authority: Internal primary source — the file being optimized.
approved.provenance: Checked-in agent contract in this repository.
approved.fit: Defines the agent interface and current weaknesses identified in engineer-prompt/review.md.

approved.name: .github/agents/teacher.agent.md (primary counterpart)
approved.authority: Internal primary source — defines the teacher handoff contract that student depends on.
approved.provenance: Checked-in agent contract in this repository.
approved.fit: Defines what teacher produces (steering, critique) and what student must consume, making it the ground truth for student handoff trigger design.

approved.name: .github/agents/.trainer-workspace/researcher.agent/iterations/iteration-1/synthesize/datasets/ (comparable agent datasets)
approved.authority: Internal — synthesized datasets for a comparable agent optimization run.
approved.provenance: Generated trainer workspace artifact in this repository.
approved.fit: Provides a structural model for synthesizing llm_judge-scored agent behavior datasets covering handoff precision, evidence reading, and output format.

rejected.name: Public student-teacher RL literature (e.g., RLHF, RLAIF papers)
rejected.reason: These model human preference feedback loops, not the structured student/teacher/trainer agent contract defined in this repository.

rejected.name: General instruction-following benchmarks (e.g., MT-Bench, AlpacaEval)
rejected.reason: These evaluate open-ended instruction quality, not the repo-specific evidence reading order, handoff triggers, and revision discipline defined in student.agent.md.

mapping_notes.evidence_reading_order: Map to eval rows where the prompt asks for a revision given incomplete or partially stale guidance; the reference behavior is to read in explicit sequence (teacher goal → STEERING.md → summary → candidate → evals) before drafting.
mapping_notes.teacher_handoff_trigger: Map to eval rows where STEERING.md is absent, older than the current candidate, or contradicts workspace evidence; the reference is to invoke teacher only in those cases, not on general uncertainty.
mapping_notes.engineer_handoff_scope: Map to eval rows where the reasoning trajectory is complete but the formatting is confusing; the reference is to invoke engineer only for structural clarity, not for content improvement.
mapping_notes.prediction_check: Map to eval rows that test whether the student correctly predicts teacher approval and either finalizes or requests exactly one more teacher turn.
mapping_notes.stopping_rule: Map to eval rows with already-strong candidates; the reference is to declare convergence rather than speculating on further improvements.
mapping_notes.defensible_revision: Map to eval rows where the teacher gave focused critique; the reference is to address exactly those points without scope expansion.

unresolved_gaps: None blocking synthesis. All required behavioral dimensions are covered by internal primary sources.
